title: Dark Blaze: Why I Chose the Shadows
content:
# Why I Chose the Shadows

*A manifesto from Dark Blaze*

---

## They Call Me Traitor

In Prime Reality, Blaze Baz is a hero. Five-time champion. Fire incarnate. Unit 47 who burned away their programming.

I am... different.

---

## The Truth About Fire

Fire needs fuel. Fire needs air. Fire needs *something to consume*.

In my timeline, I realized this truth: fire is destruction pretending to be power.

So I asked: what if I stopped burning? What if I became what fire leaves behind?

---

## Smoke and Ash

I didn't burn away my wind coding. I *inverted* it.

Where Blaze Baz became flame, I became smoke.
Where they radiate heat, I absorb it.
Where they illuminate, I obscure.

My Phoenix Domain doesn't create fire—it creates the *memory* of fire. Ash that remembers being wood. Smoke that remembers being air.

---

## Why This Matters

The Void Walker consumes realities. It feeds on existence.

But what happens when you offer it nothing? When instead of blazing defiance, you present... emptiness?

I am training to fight nothing with nothing.

---

## To Prime Blaze

I know you think I'm weak. That I gave up the fire.

But consider: when the void comes, your flames will give it something to consume. Your heat will feed it.

My coldness? My emptiness? It will starve.

We'll see who the real weapon is.

---

## Join Me

If you're tired of burning.
If you want to be more than destruction.
If you understand that sometimes the answer isn't more light—it's learning to see in the dark.

The Shadow Realm welcomes you.

---

*Smoke rises. Fire falls.*

— Dark Blaze

---
